answers.core: RichTextEffect is not suitable for this due to numerous missing features (and the continuous processing…). If the limitations of "table" should be lifted, it requires a new bbcode
answers.workaround:
It can be worked around with using `table`, but the syntax is not pretty, nor short:

```
[table=1,baseline,baseline,1][cell][font_size=15]とうじょう[/font_size][/cell][cell]登場[/cell][/table]はここ
```

![Image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/4c5176e3-37c0-49ff-aa0d-d3333fbca049)

Implementing ruby properly, could reduce this to e.g.
```[ruby rt="とうじょう"]登場[/ruby]はここ```

You can get a similar effect by using `text.replace()`, thought that won't give you horizontal alignment, nor fixing gaps.

Using RichTextEffect is not possible, you could at most create a superscript effect…
